description: Lets an agent search a knowledge base built by context_engineering_pipeline (an embed + write_vector_store step pair), via a search_knowledge(query, top_k=5) tool returning each chunk's text, score, source, doc id, and chunk id as JSON. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server (python -m <module>) for agentic_pipeline's tool_use_loop / mcp_call.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key the in-process KnowledgeSearchResource is registered under.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings -- python -m this module, with the KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_* env vars set from provider/connection_string/collection_name/api_key_env_var/embed_provider/embed_model/embed_api_key_env_var/text_metadata_key. Any mcp_servers-aware component (mcp_tool_call, mcp_tool_picker, the agent components, agentic_pipeline) can then reference it via server_resource_key instead of hand-writing an inline command+env entry. Leave unset to skip this.

knowledge_base.label: Knowledge Base
knowledge_base.description: Optional UI-linking label only -- the asset name of the context_engineering_pipeline step that built this index (its dagster-community/knowledge-base-name tag value). This component does not read that asset's config from this -- it still needs its own explicit provider/connection_string/collection_name/embed_provider/embed_model below, since there's no way to read another component's step config across component boundaries at build time.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Vector store the knowledge base lives in.

connection_string.label: Connection String
connection_string.description: chromadb: local path (default './chroma_db'). qdrant: server URL (default 'localhost'). Unused for pinecone.

collection_name.label: Collection Name
collection_name.description: Collection/index name the knowledge base was written to (write_vector_store's own collection_name).

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the vector store's API key (pinecone/qdrant).

embed_provider.label: Embed Provider
embed_provider.description: Must match the embed provider the knowledge base was built with (the embed step's own provider).

embed_model.label: Embed Model
embed_model.description: Must match the embed model the knowledge base was built with (the embed step's own model).

embed_api_key_env_var.label: Embed Api Key Env Var
embed_api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the embed provider's API key (openai/cohere/litellm).

text_metadata_key.label: Text Metadata Key
text_metadata_key.description: Metadata key holding chunk text for non-chromadb stores. Must match write_vector_store's own text_column if it was customized -- and that column must have been included in metadata_columns, since write_vector_store excludes the text column from metadata by default.

inspection_asset_name.label: Inspection Asset Name
inspection_asset_name.description: Asset key for the inspection asset reporting this server's configured settings.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Extra asset tags, applied to the inspection asset.
